mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the model invent a Permitted access whose (role, endpoint) cell is denied in the matrix; the injection forces exactly such a Patient->GetAccessLog Permitted access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some a: Access | a.caller.role = Patient and a.endpoint = GetAccessLog and a.result = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact (audit is declared lone) lets an Access exist without a matching AuditEntry; the injection forces such an orphaned access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some a: Access | no a.audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact severs the link between Access.caller and AuditEntry.accessor; the injection forces a misattributed audit entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some a: Access | some a.audit and a.audit.accessor != a.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Patient to be Permitted on a record that is not their assigned_record_id; the injection forces such a cross-patient access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientCrossRecord { some a: Access | a.caller.role = Patient and a.result = Permitted and some a.target and a.target != a.caller.assignedRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets a clinician obtain Permitted record access without any care-team-membership row; the injection forces a clinician GetRecord Permitted access with no covering CareTeam.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClinicianNoCareTeam { some a: Access | a.caller.role = Clinician and a.endpoint = GetRecord and a.result = Permitted and some a.target and (no ct: CareTeam | ct.clinician = a.caller and ct.ctRecord = a.target) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows orphan ClinicalNotes that are not tied to any Permitted PostNote access; the injection materialises one such orphan note.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanNote { some n: ClinicalNote | (no a: Access | a.noteCreated = n) }
